name: Urolithin A
description: Compound made by gut bacteria from ellagitannins in pomegranates, nuts and berries

note.text: Most human trials of urolithin A taken directly were sponsored or funded by its maker. No trial has measured aging or lifespan.

bullets: **Mitophagy inducer:** helps cells clear out worn mitochondria
**Extended worm lifespan;** improved exercise capacity in mice and rats
**Changed mitochondrial gene activity** in human muscle (4 weeks)
**In people,** effects on aging are not established
Muscle main outcomes mostly not met

practical.pharmacokinetics: Blood levels measured in a Phase 1 trial; limited human data
practical.monitored: Walk distance, muscle endurance, CRP, adverse events

regulatory.text: No questions on GRAS notice 791 for food use (2018)

references: JAMA Netw Open, urolithin A and muscle endurance in older adults, Jan 2022
Nat Med, urolithin A induces mitophagy and extends lifespan in worms, Aug 2016
